scope: Semantic and syntax expectations for a future conformance runner; not a test implementation or a claim of passing results.
fixtureLoading: Load typed fixture terms through the repository value API using the exact BNode IDs, not a Turtle parser that may relabel them. Each case starts with an independent fixture. Multiple requests in one case are sequential unless the case states otherwise.
comparison: Use fixed scoped identity for referenced BNodes. Use graph isomorphism only for explicitly generated fresh nodes, while pinning fixed BNodes. Compare result multisets unless ordering is specified. No real requests to example.invalid are intended.

cases.title: No label-only local-to-remote binding

cases.mockServiceRequirement: Remote has independent canonical bnode1 p "remote"; no shared identity namespace.

cases.title: SERVICE SILENT execution failure

cases.mockServiceRequirement: Mock endpoint does not support BNR-1; no real network request.
